newsitem.title: USA: Rubin to announce Savings Bonds changes.
newsitem.headline: Rubin to announce Savings Bonds changes.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin was due to make an announcement about U.S. Savings Bonds later Wednesday, the Treasury Department said.
USA Today reported Wednesday that the department will make changes in its Savings Bond program to provide a better return to investors in order to boost sales.

The newspaper said Savings Bonds issued after May 1 will immediately earn a higher rate based on the interest on long-term Treasury securities. The rate will be 90 percent of the average five-year Treasury yield for the previous six months.
Previously issued variable-rate Savings Bonds earn a lower, short-term rate the first five years and earn 85 percent of the five-year Treasury yield afterward.
Rubin was due to hold a press conference at 1300 EDT (1700 GMT)
